blocks.html: The provisions of this section shall govern the design, construction and chemical quantity limitations of buildings and portions thereof occupied or designed to be occupied as a nonproduction laboratory. Nonproduction laboratories shall be classified into occupancy groups in accordance with Section 427.5. The provisions of this section shall not apply to production laboratories classified in Occupancy Group F or H.
